name: HorrorCon UK
blurb: A horror convention at Magna in Rotherham with celebrity meet-and-greets, signings, cosplay and horror merch.
notes: The most recent confirmed edition ran 6-7 June 2026 at Magna (already over by this research date; confirmed by the site's own June 2026 recap posts, e.g. a 12 June 2026 'Most Horrific Creation Award' post, and by a web search). No 2027 date has been announced yet: the Schedule page only lists past-year tabs plus an unfilled '2026' tab, and the Special Guests page currently shows booking-price tiles with no names or photos, so guests could not be read for a next edition.
